title: Readiness Estimator: Animal Personhood Law
definition: Estimates Animal Personhood Law readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Animal Personhood Law components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a law hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Animal Personhood Law Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Animal Personhood Law: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Animal Personhood Law — law recognizing animal personhood.

Phase 1 — Prove (personhood tests): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (law logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (guardianship): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (habitat rights): law hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and legal-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
